06030 `anah {a:-na:'}

字根型; TWOT - 1650,1653; 動詞

欽定本 - answer 242, hear 42, testify 12, speak 8, sing 4, bear 3, cry 2,
     witness 2, give 1, misc 13; 329

1) 回答, 回應, 作證, 說話, 大喊
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) 回答, 回應
       1a2) 作證, 以證人身分回答
   1b) (Niphal)
       1b1) 命令人回答
       1b2) 得到對方回答, 得到答覆
2) (Qal) 唱, 發出悅耳的聲音
3) (Qal) 處於 ... 之中 (#賽 13:22|)
record.edic_text:
06030 `anah {aw-naw'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 1650,1653; v

AV - answer 242, hear 42, testify 12, speak 8, sing 4, bear 3, cry 2,
     witness 2, give 1, misc 13; 329

1) to answer, respond, testify, speak, shout
   1a) (Qal)
       1a1) to answer, respond to
       1a2) to testify, respond as a witness
   1b) (Niphal)
       1b1) to make answer
       1b2) to be answered, receive answer
2) (Qal) to sing, utter tunefully
3) (Qal) to dwell
